profile.name: palki
profile.description: A middle-aged female broadcast journalist speaking articulate Indian English with neutral international clarity. The pitch is medium-low, chest-resonant, and grounded, with crisp articulation and zero breathiness. Cadence is measured and deliberate, featuring strategic micro-pauses at transitions and firm downward inflections at sentence closures. The tone is authoritative, serious, analytical, and composed, suited for prime-time news reporting in a dry studio environment.
